name: srsRAN Project (5G)
description: Open source O-RAN 5G CU/DU solution from Software Radio Systems (SRS). Complete 5G RAN with L1/2/3 implementation, supports both real SDR hardware and ZMQ-based RF simulation.

docker_support.docker_evidence: Official docker/ directory with Dockerfile and docker-compose.yml. 'docker compose up --build 5gc' launches Open5GS core. Supports ZMQ-based RF simulation in containers.

eval_notes: Production-grade 5G RAN. Archived but Docker support exists. Useful for O-RAN integration evals with RIC platforms. High-fidelity gNB with real PHY layer implementation. O-RAN compliant with E2 interface. Excellent for realistic RAN configuration and troubleshooting evals. ZMQ mode enables fully containerized operation.
